data.message: I commit to 18 tons and invite each of the other 24 to opt in individually—not an all-or-nothing deal. Versus 10, 18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and all others 10, catch=250+8k, leaving 250−8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). All 18 leaves 50, then 500 or 100. This risks future income, not guaranteed long-run gains. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. Each person: what exact catch do you intend, and is it conditional?
